options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: golden
options.description: Golden query parameter. When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images marked tagged golden. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images marked not tagged golden.

options.name: hasAddonImages
options.description: HasAddonImages query parameter. When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images which have add-on images. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images which do not have add-on images.

options.name: imported
options.description: Imported query parameter. When the value is set to `true`, it will include physically imported images. Conversely, when the value is set to `false`, it will include image records from the cloud. The identifier for cloud images can be utilised to download images from Cisco.com to the disk.

options.name: integrity
options.description: Integrity query parameter. Filter with verified images using Integrity Verification Available values UNKNOWN, VERIFIED.

options.name: isAddonImages
options.description: IsAddonImages query parameter. When set to `true`, it will retrieve the images that an add-on image. When set to `false`, it will retrieve the images that are not add-on images.

options.name: name
options.description: Name query parameter. Filter with software image or add-on name. Supports partial case-insensitive search. A minimum of 3 characters is required for the search.

options.name: productNameOrdinal
options.description: ProductNameOrdinal query parameter. The product name ordinal is a unique value for each network device product. The productNameOrdinal can be obtained from the response of the API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNames`.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Site identifier to get the list of all available products under the site. The default value is the global site. See https //developer.cisco.com/docs/dna-center/get-site for siteId.

options.name: supervisorProductNameOrdinal
options.description: SupervisorProductNameOrdinal query parameter. The supervisor engine module ordinal is a unique value for each supervisor module. The `supervisorProductNameOrdinal` can be obtained from the response of API `/dna/intent/api/v1/siteWiseProductNames`.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: version
options.description: Version query parameter. Filter with image version. Supports partial case-insensitive search. A minimum of 3 characters is required for the search.
